sources.limitations: Current official county PIO directory publishes this professional address. The county profile also displays leon.page@coco.ocgov.com, an alternative domain spelling; use the PIO listing as the recorded address, reconfirm current mailbox. PIO listing is not a general complaint intake designation. County counsel represents the county, not a private complainant. Do not infer legal filing, service-of-process or independent complaint intake authorization. Confirm current mailbox, role and remit before use. Deliverability not tested.
